topic: stop a video in PowerPoint from playing automatically
core_question: How do I keep an embedded video from starting on its own during a slideshow?
answer_summary: Select the video, open Playback options, and change Start from 'Automatically' to 'On Click' so it only plays when clicked.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; writing in full careful sentences
